findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — August scoreboard is blind without them.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — 0 actions for 3 straight days signals a listing suspension or info error.

If listing is suspended, escalate to Nacer same day.
